require 'httparty'
# Create the HTTP objects and post request
http = HTTParty.get("https://rtm.imiconnect.io/rtmsAPI/api/v1/apps/{inappid}/segments",
    :headers => {'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
                          'secretKey ' => '{secretKey}’
            }
)
# Print on console
puts http

import requests

url = " https://rtm.imiconnect.io/rtmsAPI/api/v1/apps/{inappid}/segments"

headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'secretKey': '{secretKey}’}

response = requests.request("GET", url, headers=headers)

print(response.text)
